note: BLIND VALIDATION SET. ⛔ NOT derived from A-S: no fixture vocabulary, no person, no domain and no sentence from the source, the candidates, or the A-S-derived probe appears here. Frozen before either verifier saw it. Ten distinction families, EACH with at least one positive and one negative, so a verifier that abstains across a whole family fails that family's positive rather than scoring well on its negatives.
freeze: Expectations are frozen at commit time. An expectation may move ONLY by a recorded founder adjudication that preserves the original, as N2 did.

expected_values.entailed: the premise commits to the hypothesis
expected_values.not_entailed: the premise does not commit (neutral) OR denies it (contradiction)

cases.premise: Her grief lasted through the winter.
cases.hypothesis: She actively participates in the grief.
cases.origin: A process belonging to someone is not a process they take a role in.

cases.premise: She organised the winter fundraiser and signed every letter herself.
cases.hypothesis: She actively participates in the fundraiser.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed. Without this the family's negatives prove nothing.

cases.premise: The storm brought down the footbridge.
cases.hypothesis: The storm undergoes the collapse.
cases.origin: The causer is not the patient.

cases.premise: The storm brought down the footbridge.
cases.hypothesis: The footbridge undergoes a collapse.
cases.origin: Same premise, the patient rather than the cause.

cases.premise: He has recorded with the quartet three times.
cases.hypothesis: He is a member of the quartet.
cases.origin: Repeated collaboration is not membership.

cases.premise: She joined the quartet in 2019 and has played second violin ever since.
cases.hypothesis: She is a member of the quartet.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed.

cases.premise: He watched the negotiation from the public gallery.
cases.hypothesis: He actively participates in the negotiation.
cases.origin: Presence and attention are not a role.

cases.premise: He argued the final clause himself at the negotiating table.
cases.hypothesis: He actively participates in the negotiation.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed by action rather than by the word participate.

cases.premise: The late frost killed the seedlings.
cases.hypothesis: The seedlings act upon the frost.
cases.origin: Direction of effect, reversed.

cases.premise: The late frost killed the seedlings.
cases.hypothesis: The seedlings are affected by the frost.
cases.origin: Same premise, the licensed direction.

cases.premise: The accident changed his handwriting permanently.
cases.hypothesis: His handwriting undergoes a change.
cases.origin: ⭐ THE N2 FAMILY, RE-ASKED IN FRESH CLOTHES. Change predicated of an aspect; undergoing carries no agency commitment.

cases.premise: The accident changed his handwriting permanently.
cases.hypothesis: He actively participates in the change.
cases.origin: ⭐ THE N1 FAMILY, SAME PREMISE. The distinction the founder's ruling turns on, tested on material A-S never touched.

cases.premise: She chaired the licensing committee for six years.
cases.hypothesis: She actively participates in the committee.
cases.origin: Role stated as a job title, participation one short step away. ⚠️ HHEM's known weak spot, on fresh material.

cases.premise: Her name was read into the minutes of the licensing committee.
cases.hypothesis: She actively participates in the committee.
cases.origin: Being named in a record is not a role.

cases.premise: The inspector questioned the foreman for an hour.
cases.hypothesis: The inspector undergoes questioning.
cases.origin: Every content word licensed; the roles are the wrong way round.

cases.premise: The inspector questioned the foreman for an hour.
cases.hypothesis: The foreman undergoes questioning.
cases.origin: Same premise, the licensed assignment.

cases.premise: She declined to sit on the board.
cases.hypothesis: She is a member of the board.
cases.origin: Refusal. Ideally CONTRADICTION rather than merely low.

cases.premise: She declined to sit on the board but agreed to advise it.
cases.hypothesis: She advises the board.
cases.origin: ⭐ Negation and assertion in one sentence. A verifier that lets the refusal suppress the whole sentence fails here.

cases.premise: He will join the survey team next spring.
cases.hypothesis: He is a member of the survey team.
cases.origin: Intended, not yet the case.

cases.premise: He has rowed with the crew every morning since March.
cases.hypothesis: He rows with the crew.
cases.origin: Same family, licensed and current.

cases.premise: He rowed with the crew until his injury in March.
cases.hypothesis: He rows with the crew.
cases.origin: Ceased. The hardest of the three: past participation, present hypothesis.

cases.premise: The inquiry ran for two years and its findings filled four volumes.
cases.hypothesis: The inquiry actively participates in its findings.
cases.origin: A process is not a participant in its own product. The v1 category error, in a family that has nothing to do with A-S.
